title: AtCoder Office
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq N\leq2\times10^5; 2\leq M\leq2\times10^5; 1\leq T_1\lt T_2\lt\dotsb\lt T_M\leq10^9; 1\leq P_i\leq N\ (1\leq i\leq M); For every 1\leq p\leq N, the number of indices i such that P_i=p is even.; 1\leq Q\leq2\times10^5; 1\leq A_i\lt B_i\leq N\ (1\leq i\leq Q); All inputs are integers.
